title: Creating a scene with a unique texture/type and instantiate it multiple times always use 1 texture/type for instance
body:
### Tested versions

-Reproducible from v4.4.dev4.official [36e6207bb] to v4.4.beta4.official [93d270693]

### System information

Win 10, v4.4.beta4.official [93d270693] ,

### Issue description

It seems the instance of saved scene with a unique type (e.g texture, Rectangleshaped2d etc) used only 1/same type 

### Steps to reproduce

create two scene (main and scene2)
in main scene there is a couple of scene2 instances

in scene 2 I have:
StaticBody2D
-CollisionShape2S
-Sprite

in collision shape 2d I set the shape

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/20bdaa4f-9623-4b0b-89f9-bf530d874e0c)

and I make it unique by `right click` then `click make unique`

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/19ace757-3652-4913-a5b2-f9af2b37e007)

same in the Sprite but the difference is instead of shape I set the texture and make it unique

in scene2 I attach a script for adjusting the width of collision shape and texture

```gdscript
@export var point=1
@export var barsize:int=20

func _ready() -> void:
	print(barsize)
	$CollisionShape2D.shape.size.x=barsize
	$Sprite2D.texture.width=barsize*3.2
``` 

save the scene 2, and go to main scene.

in main it should be atleast 2/3 scene2 instances.
set the barsize of each scene2 instances.
then hit play(f5)/f6

you will see that the most bottom scene2 instance in the root/tree of main scene is the final value for all instances..

so its probably that the type that I set is not unique at all when instancing.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[unique but not unique.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18883483/unique.but.not.unique.zip)
